contracts.design-v2: Act as the architect of this service. Read the requirements and specify its interface as a single JSON object (no prose) containing "id_type" (either "string" or "integer"), "operations" (the operation names) and "status" (HTTP status code for each of the situations "created", "exists", "missing", "invalid_id", "archived_put").
contracts.impl-v1: You are the programmer. Implement the service as one Python class named DocumentStore, in memory, standard library only, no input/output. Methods: create(doc_id, body) -> int; read(doc_id) -> always a 2-tuple (status, body or None); put(doc_id, body) -> int; archive(doc_id) -> int; list() -> sorted list of all identifiers, archived ones included. Use exactly the status codes of the design. Identifiers of the wrong type are invalid. Return ONLY one ```python code block.
